HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Bring a customer’s billing records together in a clear account summary prepared for review or printing.

01

Select a customer

Open the customer whose account activity you need to review.

02

Choose the period

Focus the statement on the relevant billing dates where filtering is available.

03

Review account activity

Check invoice entries, recorded payments, credits, and remaining balances.

04

Prepare the statement

Create a professional printable or PDF-ready account summary.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about customer statements

What appears on a customer statement?

Statements can summarize customer invoices, recorded payments, supported credits, and outstanding balances.

Can statements be filtered by date?

The requested statement workflow includes date-based review where supported by the active application.

Can I create a PDF statement?

The page describes printable, PDF-ready statements; use the export options available in your active application.

Does a statement change invoice data?

A statement is presented as an account summary of existing billing records.
